description: Advocates higher taxation of capital and wealth; backed the JUSO 99% Initiative and opposed corporate tax relief, arguing taxation should follow economic capacity.
Frames climate change as a class issue; supports a Green New Deal, expansion of solar energy and non-profit housing, and reductions in private car and air travel.
Co-authored 'Die Service-Public-Revolution'; supports expansion of public services, social security for the self-employed, lower healthcare premiums and dismissal protection.
Self-identified feminist; supports parental-leave reform, free external childcare, hiring quotas and revaluation of care work.
Strong advocate for refugees and asylum seekers, tied to his family history; affiliated with several migration and asylum organisations.
Supported the Responsible Business (Konzernverantwortungs-) Initiative requiring Swiss companies to be liable for human-rights abuses abroad.
In favour of eventual EU membership conditional on wage protection and safeguarding of public services.
Co-founded the Mittelland rail-link committee with FDP's Thierry Burkart to improve rail connections in Aargau.
Active on Kosovo relations and took on a political godparenthood for a Belarusian political prisoner.
